name: eliabetech-sistema-de-login
description: Autenticação com Next.js/React, NestJS sobre Express e MySQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @eliabetech/api" "npm run dev -w @eliabetech/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eliabetech/api && npm run build -w @eliabetech/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:prod -w @eliabetech/api" "npm run start -w @eliabetech/web"
